teaser.en: It grows into thickets so dense that one Digo name means 'closing pile': it shuts the path.
teaser.sw: Huota na kuwa vichaka vizito mno hivi kwamba mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo linamaanisha 'rundo linalofunga': hufunga njia.

summary.en: *Mpande* is a smooth-barked tree of dry evergreen and riverine forest that grows into dense thickets. Its second Digo name, *chifunga sandzu*, describes how it closes forest paths.
summary.sw: *Mpande*, au *mgodoma*, ni mti wenye gome laini wa misitu mikavu ya kijani mwaka mzima na misitu ya kando ya mito, unaoota na kuwa vichaka vizito. Jina lake la pili la Kidigo, *chifunga sandzu*, linaeleza jinsi unavyofunga njia za msituni.

about.en:
*Mpande* is a tree with a slightly buttressed trunk and smooth grey bark. Each leaf has three to five leaflets arranged alternately along the stalk. The flowers are white, and the pods are short and thick.

The genus name, *Scorodophloeus*, means 'garlic bark'.
about.sw:
*Mpande* ni mti wenye shina lenye mizizi-ukuta midogo na gome laini la kijivu. Kila jani lina vijani vitatu hadi vitano vilivyopangwa kwa kupishana kando ya shina la jani. Maua ni meupe, na maganda ni mafupi na manene.

Jina la jenasi, *Scorodophloeus*, linamaanisha 'gome la kitunguu saumu'.

where.en: It grows in lowland dry evergreen forest and riverine forest, where it can form thickets.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu mikavu ya kijani mwaka mzima ya nyanda za chini na katika misitu ya kando ya mito, ambapo unaweza kutengeneza vichaka vizito.

uses.en: No particular use for *mpande* has been recorded.

culture.en: Its second name tells you how it grows. *Chifunga sandzu* means 'closing pile', because the tree forms thickets that close the path.
culture.sw: Jina lake la pili linakueleza jinsi unavyokua. *Chifunga sandzu* linamaanisha 'rundo linalofunga', kwa sababu mti huu hutengeneza vichaka vinavyofunga njia.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mpande* and *chifunga sandzu*. The Duruma name, *kifunga tanzu*, is almost the same. In Swahili it is *mgodoma*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mpande* na *chifunga sandzu*. Jina la Kiduruma, *kifunga tanzu*, linakaribiana sana nalo. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mgodoma*.

reason.en: Cynometra, another bean-family tree of coastal woodland
reason.sw: Cynometra, mti mwingine wa jamii ya kunde wa misitu ya pwani
